# 1417 — fileman S3 backend: AssumeRole for cross-tenant buckets + one credential path

Board: https://maestromojo.com/workspaces/#/board/11?item=1417
Stage at claim: planned -> building (maestro-auto batch with #1418, #1419)

## Approved scope (user decisions at the gate, 2026-08-06)

- **Scope**: build Phase 2 (cross-account AssumeRole) PLUS the credential-path
  cleanup. Drop the Phase 1 framing — ambient credentials already work
  (`boto3/session.py:84-98` takes the `any(credentials_kwargs.values())` false
  branch and never calls `set_credentials`), and `validate_configuration` is dead
  code (`validate_backend_config` has no runtime caller).
- **Authz**: `assume_role_arn` / `external_id` setters are **superuser-gated**.
  `on_rest_save_field` (`mojo/models/rest.py:1858-1866`) dispatches any
  `set_<key>`, and `FileManager.SAVE_PERMS = ["manage_files", "files"]` is
  group-level — a bare setter is a confused-deputy escalation.

The full plan, challenge dispositions and contracts live on the board item.
